# Decouple Runner from UI Implementation Details

## Context

The `WorkflowRunner::run_with_ui()` in `src/runner/workflow.rs` has two coupling leaks to UI internals, despite the codebase having a well-designed `UserInterface` trait:

1. **BivvyTheme in Runner** (line 317): Runner creates `BivvyTheme::new()` and calls `theme.format_skipped()`, `theme.step_number.apply_to()`, `theme.step_title.apply_to()`, `theme.dim.apply_to()` to build styled strings. Formatting is a UI concern.

2. **indicatif::ProgressBar leaks through SpinnerHandle** (`ui/mod.rs:195`): `fn progress_bar() -> Option<ProgressBar>` exposes a concrete `indicatif` type. The runner imports `live_output_callback` from `ui::spinner` and passes the bar to it.

## Plan

### Part 1: Move theme formatting into the UI trait

**Add two methods to `UserInterface` trait** in `src/ui/mod.rs`:
- `fn format_step_header(&self, index: usize, total: usize, name: &str, title: &str) -> String` — formats `[1/7] name — title`
- `fn format_status(&self, status: StatusKind, message: &str) -> String` — formats `○ Skipped (reason)`

Default implementations use plain text (`StatusKind::format_plain`). Override in `TerminalUI` (`src/ui/terminal.rs`) to use `self.theme`.

**Update `run_with_ui()`** to call `ui.format_step_header()` / `ui.format_status()` instead of using `BivvyTheme` directly. Remove `use crate::ui::theme::BivvyTheme` from `workflow.rs`.

### Part 2: Replace `progress_bar()` with `create_output_callback()`

**Replace `SpinnerHandle::progress_bar()`** with:
```rust
fn create_output_callback(&self, base_message: &str, indent: usize, max_lines: usize) -> Option<OutputCallback>
```
Default returns `None`. `ProgressSpinner` implements it by calling `live_output_callback` internally.

**Update `run_with_ui()`** to call `spinner.create_output_callback()` instead of `spinner.progress_bar()` + `live_output_callback()`. Remove `use crate::ui::spinner::live_output_callback` and `use indicatif::ProgressBar` from `ui/mod.rs`.

**Update spinner tests** to test `create_output_callback` instead of `progress_bar`.

Remove the now-unused `bar_clone()` method from `ProgressSpinner`.

## Files to modify

| File | Changes |
|------|---------|
| `src/ui/mod.rs` | Add `format_step_header`, `format_status` to `UserInterface`. Replace `progress_bar()` with `create_output_callback()` on `SpinnerHandle`. Remove `use indicatif::ProgressBar` |
| `src/ui/terminal.rs` | Override `format_step_header` and `format_status` using `self.theme` |
| `src/ui/spinner.rs` | Implement `create_output_callback` on `ProgressSpinner`. Remove `progress_bar()` impl and `bar_clone()`. Update tests |
| `src/runner/workflow.rs` | Use new trait methods. Remove `BivvyTheme` and `live_output_callback` imports |

## Verification

1. `cargo test --all-features` — all existing tests pass
2. `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` — no warnings
3. `cargo fmt -- --check` — formatted
4. Confirm `runner/workflow.rs` no longer imports anything from `ui::theme` or `ui::spinner`
